'''''Chasmanthe aethiopica''''', the '''cobra lily''', is a perennial plant and geophyte belonging to the genus ''[[Chasmanthe]]'' and is part of the [[fynbos]].<ref>http://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=1526-1 SANBI Redlist</ref> The plant is endemic to the [[Eastern Cape|Eastern]] and [[Western Cape]].<ref>http://plantsoftheworldonline.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:436372-1 Plants of the World</ref> The plant grows to a height of 40 to 65 cm and flowers from April to July. The flowers are red-purple.<ref>{{cite web | title=Chasmanthe aethiopica | PlantZAfrica | url=https://pza.sanbi.org/chasmanthe-aethiopica }}</ref>
